resources.string: Locked apps can be opened freely. Tap to turn Krypt Locker back on in Accessibility settings.
Ask your Guardian for access. The app opens as soon as they approve.

plurals.name: lock_status_sent
plurals.item: Request sent. When your Guardian approves, tap the link in their reply, or copy the reply and tap Paste approval link, and %1$s will open. Requests expire after %2$d minute.
Request sent. When your Guardian approves, tap the link in their reply, or copy the reply and tap Paste approval link, and %1$s will open. Requests expire after %2$d minutes.

resources.string: Krypt isn\'t set up yet. Open Krypt and set a Guardian PIN first.
Couldn\'t create the request. Please try again.
No approval link on the clipboard. Copy your Guardian\'s whole reply first.
Krypt unlock request for %1$s.\nTap the link to review it. If it doesn\'t open, copy this whole message, open Krypt and tap Paste link.\n%2$s
Krypt approval for %1$s.\nTap the link to unlock it. If it doesn\'t open, copy this whole message, open the locked app and tap Paste approval link.\n%2$s
No Krypt link found. Copy the whole message that contains the link first.
Krypt can\'t open this link. Ask for a new unlock request.
Krypt needs Accessibility access to see which app is being launched and block locked apps until your Guardian approves. Krypt does not read your app content and does not send any data off the device.
Blocks locked apps from opening until your Guardian approves.
Required so Krypt cannot be uninstalled without first being disabled here. Krypt does not use any other device-admin privilege.
Disabling Krypt device admin will allow anyone to uninstall Krypt and remove protection from your locked apps. Are you sure?
Krypt uses Device Admin to make itself harder to uninstall, so a determined user has to visit Settings first.
Enter the Guardian PIN to manage locked apps.
The Guardian PIN isn\'t set up on this device.
Too many wrong PINs. Try again in %1$d s.
Too many wrong PINs. Try again in %1$d min.
Krypt needs Accessibility access so it can detect when a locked app is about to open and block it. Krypt does not read your app content.
Krypt needs this permission so it can bring up its lock screen the moment you open a locked app.
Activating Device Admin makes Krypt harder to uninstall without Guardian approval. Krypt does not use any other admin privilege.
Krypt posts a notification when a new app gets auto-locked. On Android 13+ this needs your permission.
Krypt must stay running in the background. Grant the battery-optimisation exemption so the OS does not kill it while your screen is off.
Hand this device to your Guardian. They will set a 4–6 digit PIN that only they know. You will not see the PIN — this is what protects your locked apps.
Saved. Hand the phone back to the owner.
PIN must be at least 4 digits.
Could not save the PIN. Please try again.
This approval doesn\'t match a pending unlock request.
Your original request expired before the approval arrived.
This device isn\'t set up yet. Open Krypt first.
Approve unlocking this app for your Subject device?
Approval sent. You can close this screen.
